user.title: Wake the scale
user.description:
The scale is switched off and invisible until it is used.

1. Place it on a hard floor
2. Step on it (barefoot, for body composition)
3. Press **Submit** and stay on it

Home Assistant will watch for it for {seconds} seconds.

profile.title: Body profile
profile.description: The scale computes body fat, water, muscle and the rest on-device from this profile, so these values decide whether those readings are meaningful. Weight is unaffected. Use the same profile slot you normally weigh under on the scale itself.

pick.title: Select your scale
pick.description: These scales are advertising right now.

abort.already_configured: This scale is already set up

progress.scanning: Looking for the scale — step on it now and stay on it…

error.not_found: No scale found. It only transmits while awake, so step on it just before pressing Submit, and keep it within range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

init.title: Body profile
init.description: Changing this reconnects the scale so it recomputes with the new profile.

user.title: Add a person
user.description: Bind an on-scale profile slot to a Home Assistant user. The scale computes body composition on-device from this profile, so these values decide whether those readings mean anything — weight is unaffected. The approximate weight is how the integration tells people apart; it is refined automatically after each weigh-in.

reconfigure.title: Edit person
reconfigure.description: Bind an on-scale profile slot to a Home Assistant user. The scale computes body composition on-device from this profile, so these values decide whether those readings mean anything — weight is unaffected. The approximate weight is how the integration tells people apart; it is refined automatically after each weigh-in.

reassign_measurement.name: Reassign measurement
reassign_measurement.description: Move the most recent weigh-in to a different person. Weight and a recomputed BMI move across; body composition does not, because the scale calculated it for the other person's profile.

person.name: Person
person.description: Name of the person to attribute the weigh-in to.
